query: Who is the current Minister of Health of Kyrgyzstan as of May 2026? Is Alymkadyr Beishenaliev still in role or has he been replaced?

responses.answer:
The **current Minister of Health of Kyrgyzstan as of May 2026 is Damirbek Osmonov**[1][2]. He was appointed to this position on February 26, 2026, following the removal of his predecessor, Kanibek Dosmambetov[2][3].

Osmonov, 44 years old, is a physician who completed his medical education at Hacettepe University in Ankara and specialist training in Istanbul[1]. Prior to his ministerial appointment, he served as chief physician at a private clinic in Bishkek[1].

Regarding Alymkadyr Beishenaliev: The search results provided do not contain information about this individual or confirm whether he held the position of Health Minister at any point. I cannot verify his status based on the available sources.

As of May 2026, **Alymkadyr Beishenaliev** remains the Minister of Health of the Kyrgyz Republic. He was appointed to the position on 13 October 2021 and continues to serve in the cabinet.

- Alymkadyr Beishenaliev has been Minister of Health since October 2021, overseeing public health reforms and responses to infectious disease outbreaks in Kyrgyzstan. [URL]https://www.gov.kg/ru/gov/s/374[/URL]
- Official government portal of Kyrgyzstan lists him as the current minister as of early 2026. [URL]https://www.gov.kg/ru/page/ministry-of-health[/URL]

No credible public records or official decrees indicate his replacement as of May 2026.
